title: Vitali Vitaliev
gist: An author index page for Ukrainian-born journalist Vitali Vitaliev listing his Prospect 'Second life' columns. It contains headlines only, with no argued content.

insights.claim: Vitali Vitaliev, a Ukrainian-born journalist who has worked in Russia, the UK, Australia and Ireland, writes a recurring 'Second life' column for Prospect.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Identifies a regular cultural-commentary voice with a Soviet-era lens.

insights.claim: One listed Vitaliev column frames what happened to Jason Arday as a Soviet-style tragedy.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Headline only; signals Soviet analogies being applied to UK campus controversies.
insights.quote: Second life: What happened to Jason Arday was a soviet-style tragedy
insights.locator: Second life: What happened to Jason

insights.claim: Another listed Vitaliev column claims AI wrongly believes he made millions from Yeezy sneakers, pointing to AI hallucination about individuals.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Headline-level example of AI factual errors about real people, a reputational and liability theme for AI products.
insights.quote: Second life: AI thinks I have made millions from Yeezy sneakers
